# 67 open technology projects awarded NGI grants

*This announcement was originally published in the website of the*[NLnet Foundation](https://nlnet.nl/news/2026/20260616-67-new-projects.html)*.*

We are happy to announce that 67 new projects have been awarded grants today as part of the [Next Generation Internet](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/next-generation-internet-initiative) initiative, across three different funds: [NGI Zero Commons Fund](https://nlnet.nl/commonsfund), [NGI TALER](https://nlnet.nl/taler) and [NGI Fediversity](https://nlnet.nl/fediversity). We congratulate the developers and engineers involved with these projects, and thank them for their forthcoming contribution to an open, resilient and human-centered internet. The selection covers the entire technology stack from trustworthy open hardware, to services & applications providing user autonomy.

## Privacy-preserving payments and a hosting stack

An NGI Pilot programme is executed by a consortium of hands-on partners that work on a practical solution in a specific domain. [NGI Taler](https://nlnet.nl/taler) is building an electronic payment system that offers privacy for those that make payments, while enforcing transparency on those that sell. [NGI Fediversity](https://nlnet.nl/fediversity) is a comprehensive effort to bring easy-to-use, hosted internet services with *service portability* and *personal freedom* at their core to everyone. Each pilot has dedicated part of its budget for supporting outside projects that contribute to these goals. In the December 2025 and February 2026 open calls, six projects have been selected to contribute to the two pilots: [Fleetbase × Taler](https://nlnet.nl/project/Fleetbase-Taler) is making low-cost, privacy friendly payments for logistics software, [Taler PoS](https://nlnet.nl/project/TALER-POS) addresses Point-of-Sale software, and two other projects are delivering [integration of GNU Taler in the functional package management system GNU Guix](https://nlnet.nl/project/Taler-Guix-packaging) and [automated UI testing and type generation](https://nlnet.nl/project/Taler-iOS-automation) for Taler's iOS app. The two projects granted within NGI Fediversity are the file-hosting platform [Nocloud](https://nlnet.nl/project/Nocloud/) and [Magic Nix VFS](https://nlnet.nl/project/Magic-Nix-VFS) — which allows for the transparent distribution of software on-demand from cache servers to client machines, effectively creating a gigantic "virtual Nix store" available on demand.

## From flow batteries to causal AI

The projects granted within [NGI Zero Commons Fund](https://nlnet.nl/commonsfund) range from an open hardware [Hybrid Flow Battery](https://nlnet.nl/project/HybridFlowBattery) to standards-compliant [distributed OpenPGP key server](https://nlnet.nl/project/Hockeypuck-distributed-keys), [virtualised microservices](https://nlnet.nl/project/Redox-virtualised-microservices) in the Rust-based operating system Redox and an ambitious [DHT](https://nlnet.nl/project/FogDHT) project, a verification and compliance tool for the EUDI Wallet system ([Ruuti](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ruuti)) and an ActivityPub testing tool ([DrFed](https://nlnet.nl/project/DrFed)). There are various efforts around independent browsers and browser engines, e.g. improving [writing modes](https://nlnet.nl/project/Servo-writingmodes) and [multimedia](https://nlnet.nl/project/Servo-multimedia) support in Servo, as well as a new effort called [Bisque](https://nlnet.nl/project/Bisque) (actually built on top of Servo) that aims to improve desktop integration of the browser.

There are tools for chips/FPGA design such as [CflexHDL](https://nlnet.nl/project/CflexHDL), a porting effort for [Apicula](https://nlnet.nl/project/Apicula-GW5A) for the Gowin GW5A platform, and a libre-licensed [CPU that will support a programmable decoder](https://nlnet.nl/project/Libre-Chip-programmabledecoder) to be able to support multiple instruction sets in a single chip. [Dot Product Unit](https://nlnet.nl/project/DPU) (DPU) is an open-source hardware IP block for efficient vector dot-product computation across multiple numeric formats. At the level of Printed Circuit Boards there is a new effort adding various new format importers to [Ringdove EDA](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ringdove-alienformats). There is also concrete hardware, such as the innovative open hardware encryption device [Einszeit](https://nlnet.nl/project/Einszeit) and the reverse engineering platform [Unbinare RET](https://nlnet.nl/project/Unbinare-RET-Platform), and the open hardware phone [mikroPhone](https://nlnet.nl/project/mikroPhone-drivers).

Scientists and engineers will be happy to see [accessibility improvements to the LaTeX ecosystem](https://nlnet.nl/project/LaTeX-Ecosystem-A11y), a framework for [Zotero plugins](https://nlnet.nl/project/Zotero-plugin-ecosystem), tools for [Selective Data Disclosure](https://nlnet.nl/project/SelectiveDataDisclosure), the cross-platform GPU multi-physics simulation engine [Nexus](https://nlnet.nl/project/Nexus), the tool [QUATT](https://nlnet.nl/project/QUATT) which helps to design and understand solid-state quantum circuits, [procedural and mathematical visualizations](https://nlnet.nl/project/sacr3d), and integrationg of the volume computation and high dimensions sampling solution [Ovolesti](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ovolesti) in GNU Octave. [Open Instrument Control](https://nlnet.nl/project/OpenInstrumentControl) will implement a variety of open-source transport-level protocols for communicating with test and measurement (T&M) instruments. And [pgmpy](https://nlnet.nl/project/pgmpy) is software for causal AI, the branch of machine learning concerned with cause-and-effect relationships rather than prediction alone. [AppBundler](https://nlnet.nl/project/AppBundler-expansion) makes distribution of Julia software easier.

There is continued innovation at the network and protocol level with [MultiPath TCP](https://nlnet.nl/project/MPTCP-LinuxMobile) and [microTCP](https://nlnet.nl/project/microTCP), enhancements to the [Routing Policy Specification Language](https://nlnet.nl/project/RPSL-enhancements) and (on a completely different layer of the network) a solution to help with the rollout of actual physical [(optical) Fiber infrastructure](https://nlnet.nl/project/FiberQ). [DMRSEC](https://nlnet.nl/project/DMRSEC) will look into the security of Digital Mobile Radio, an important standard used by emergency services and critical infrastructure globally.

OS innovation and evolution takes place through adding [kernel observability to Landlock](https://nlnet.nl/project/Landlock-kernelobservability), the new sandboxing solution [Island](https://nlnet.nl/project/Island-Sandboxing), improving [xdgmime](https://nlnet.nl/project/xdgmime). There are several wayland related projects, such as the non-monolithic Wayland compositor River that has a new [window management protocol](https://nlnet.nl/project/River-protocol) to separate concerns, another effort adding [support for electrophoretic/e-reader displays in Wayland](https://nlnet.nl/project/epd-wayland) as well as adding Wayland support to the [Disthro (audio) plugin framework](https://nlnet.nl/project/DPF). Software developers concerned about software supply chain security will love [SecObservePlus](https://nlnet.nl/project/SecObservePlus) and [SBOMVert](https://nlnet.nl/project/SBOMVert).

There is fundamental work on providing secure alternatives for critical environments such as a from-scratch implementation of the Erlang VM ([AtomVM](https://nlnet.nl/project/AtomVM)). [Funk](https://nlnet.nl/project/Funk) is a compiler for hard real-time, functionally safe systems. There is also a compiler from Scheme to JavaScript, Assembly (x86), C, Python, Prolog and twenty other languages ([Ribbit](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ribbit)), and a project improving support for [generalized algebraic data types in Haskell](https://nlnet.nl/project/Haskell-GADT-GHC.402) which should help prevent a whole class of security issues in software written in Haskell.

In the area of mapping, there are various efforts such as projects to improve [iD-tagging](https://nlnet.nl/project/OSM-iD-tagging) and [iD-presets](https://nlnet.nl/project/OSM-iD-presets) in OpenStreetMap, and the FOSS mobile mapping tool [CoMaps](https://nlnet.nl/project/CoMaps). There are also projects around other large data commons, such as [Open Food Facts](https://nlnet.nl/project/OFF-Explorer).

Amond the grantees are valuable end user applications as well, such as adding Collabora Online's [Follow-me-slideshow to videoconferencing tool Jitsi](https://nlnet.nl/project/Follow-me-slideshow-Jitsi), the podcast hosting tool [Castopod](https://nlnet.nl/project/Castopod-v2), the communication client [Posca](https://nlnet.nl/project/Posca), and ERP tool [Dolibarr](https://nlnet.nl/project/Dolibarr-e-invoice) — with the latter gaining support for modern European e-invoicing standards. By improving the widely used [SCIM python framework](https://nlnet.nl/project/SCIM-integrations), a variety of integrations of this privacy friendly log-in mechanism will be unlocked. [Karrot](https://nlnet.nl/project/Karrot-UX) is social software for group coordination and community-building. And by adding Tor to [SelfPrivacy](https://nlnet.nl/project/SelfPrivacy-Tor), several new scenario's for self-hosting are unlocked. Video as one of the largest consumers of internet capacity is not forgotten: next to the video streaming platforms [MistServer](https://nlnet.nl/project/MistServer-VoD) and [PeerTube](https://nlnet.nl/project/PeerTube-Scalability), there is FOSDEM's hardware video streaming solution [Fazantix](https://nlnet.nl/project/Fazantix).

## Toward a digital commons

The [NGI Zero Commons Fund](https://nlnet.nl/commonsfund/) provides grants to people who help build the digital commons. Because all projects are free and open source technologies, all outcomes can be freely used, studied, shared and moderated by anyone. Together they provide the building blocks for a information and communication infrastructure that promotes digital autonomy and serves the common good. [NGI Zero](https://nlnet.nl/NGI0/) is a coalition of non-profit organisations led by NLnet that provides [practical](https://nlnet.nl/NGI0/services/) and [financial](https://nlnet.nl/funding.html) support to projects fix the internet. NGI Zero is made possible with financial support from the [European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/).

## Meet the new projects!

### Trustworthy hardware and manufacturing

- [Apicula GW5A 60k & 138k](https://nlnet.nl/project/Apicula-GW5A) — Open source toolchain for Gowin FPGAs
- [CflexHDL](https://nlnet.nl/project/CflexHDL)— C-based flexible hardware/software systems design
- [Dot Product Unit - DPU](https://nlnet.nl/project/DPU) — Hardware accelerator for computing vector dot products
- [Einszeit Quantum-Proof Encryption](https://nlnet.nl/project/Einszeit) — Quantum-proof hardware security platform
- [Fazantix video streaming box](https://nlnet.nl/project/Fazantix) — All-in-one Open Hardware capture and streaming box
- [Funk](https://nlnet.nl/project/Funk) — Compiler for hard real-time, functionally safe systems
- [Iron Electrolytes and Stacks for Flow Batteries](https://nlnet.nl/project/HybridFlowBattery) — Hybrid battery technology built from readily available materials:
- [Libre-Chip Programmable Decoder](https://nlnet.nl/project/Libre-Chip-programmabledecoder)— Run multiple ISAs at full speed with an open CPU
- [mikroPhone drivers + GUI](https://nlnet.nl/project/mikroPhone-drivers) — Full-featured expandable mobile phone from off-the-shelf components
- [pcb-rnd + sch-rnd alien formats](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ringdove-alienformats) — Importers for proprietary file formats in Ringdove EDA
- [QUAntum bits of This and That (QUATT)](https://nlnet.nl/project/QUATT) — Design and understand solid-state quantum circuits
- [Reverse Engineering Toolkit: Platform](https://nlnet.nl/project/Unbinare-RET-Platform) — Development platform for signal processing

### Network infrastructure incl. routing, P2P and VPN

- [FiberQ + FiberQ Designer](https://nlnet.nl/project/FiberQ) — Interoperable open tooling for fiber rollout
- [Multipath TCP on Linux mobile devices](https://nlnet.nl/project/MPTCP-LinuxMobile)— Improve mobile support for MPTCP and add cost-aware path control
- [RPSL member enhancements](https://nlnet.nl/project/RPSL-enhancements)— Enhance Routing Policy Specification Language + IRRDv4 implementation
- [Self-hostable SelfPrivacy via Tor](https://nlnet.nl/project/SelfPrivacy-Tor) — Making SelfPrivacy Resilient and Self-hostable via Tor with self-signed SSL certificates.
- [µTCP](https://nlnet.nl/project/microTCP) — TCP/IP implementation derived from HOL4 formal specification

### Software engineering, protocols, interoperability, cryptography, algorithms, proofs

- [DMRSEC](https://nlnet.nl/project/DMRSEC) — Security audit of Digital Mobile Radio
- [Nexus](https://nlnet.nl/project/Nexus) — Cross-platform GPU multiphysics simulation for games, robotics, and machine learning
- [Ovolesti](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ovolesti) — Gnu Octave bindings for the volesti library
- [Ribbit](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ribbit) — Ribbit: An Portable Platform for Language Interoperability
- [Stable GADT constructor syntax in Haskell](https://nlnet.nl/project/Haskell-GADT-GHC.402)— Generalized Algebraic Data Types for GHC (#402)
- [Towards AtomVM v1.0](https://nlnet.nl/project/AtomVM) — From-scratch implementation of the Erlang

### Operating Systems, firmware and virtualisation

- [DISTRHO Plugin Framework](https://nlnet.nl/project/DPF) — Wayland, Web UIs and documentation/polishing for DPF
- [Landlock observability and telemetry](https://nlnet.nl/project/Landlock-kernelobservability) — Add kernel observability and telemetry features to Linux Security Module
- [PrismaFS](https://nlnet.nl/project/PrismaFS) — Portable userspace filesystem with isolated session layer
- [River window management protocol](https://nlnet.nl/project/River-protocol)— Dedicated window management protocol for non-monolithic Wayland compositors
- [Servo Multimedia](https://nlnet.nl/project/Servo-multimedia) — Improve multimedia support in Servo browser
- [Servo Writing Modes](https://nlnet.nl/project/Servo-writingmodes) — Improve Servo layout engine with writing modes
- [Virtualized Redox](https://nlnet.nl/project/Redox-virtualised-microservices) — Redox as a Web Server Runtime, hosted in a Virtual Machine
- [Bisque](https://nlnet.nl/project/Bisque) — New Web browser based on Servo engine
- [wayland-epd](https://nlnet.nl/project/epd-wayland)— Better desktop rendering on electrophoretic displays
- [xdgmime](https://nlnet.nl/project/xdgmime) — Unit and fuzz testing for reference shared-mime-info implementation
- [Integration of GNU Taler in GNU Guix](https://nlnet.nl/project/Taler-Guix-packaging/) — Package Taler components in Guix functional package manager
- [Magic Nix VFS](https://nlnet.nl/project/Magic-Nix-VFS/) — Lazy-loading Virtual File System for the Nix store
- [Island sandboxing tool](https://nlnet.nl/project/Island-Sandboxing/)— Sandboxing tool to help secure day-to-day workflows

### Measurement, monitoring, analysis and abuse handling

- [Alternative algorithms for selective data disclosure](https://nlnet.nl/project/SelectiveDataDisclosure) — Alternative Algorithms for Privacy Audits of Aggregated Tabular Data
- [Dep-scan memory-safety risk analysis](https://nlnet.nl/project/OWASP-dep-scan-memorysafety) — Static analysis to identify memory-safety issues
- [DrFed](https://nlnet.nl/project/DrFed) — Web-based development and debugging platform for ActivityPub
- [Open Instrument Control (OIC)](https://nlnet.nl/project/OpenInstrumentControl)— Open protocols for test and measurement
- [os-test expansion](https://nlnet.nl/project/os-test) — Comprehensive POSIX compliance test suite for operating system implementations
- [SBOMVert](https://nlnet.nl/project/SBOMVert)— Generate, compare, and unify SBOMs and vulnerability reports
- [SecObserve+](https://nlnet.nl/project/SecObservePlus) — Automated workflow for software supply chain management

### Middleware and identity

- [AppBundler Expansion](https://nlnet.nl/project/AppBundler-expansion) — Tool to create cross-platform installers
- [Distributed key management in Hockeypuck](https://nlnet.nl/project/Hockeypuck-distributed-keys) — Next generation OpenPGP Keyserver
- [SCIM Python Framework and Integrations](https://nlnet.nl/project/SCIM-integrations) — Further integration of System for Cross-domain Identity Management

### Decentralised solutions, including blockchain/distributed ledger

- [FogDHT](https://nlnet.nl/project/FogDHT) — Secure, embeddable Distributed Hash Table in Rust
- [Nocloud](https://nlnet.nl/project/Nocloud/)— Remote storage platform for individuals and families

### Data and AI

- [Open Food Facts Explorer](https://nlnet.nl/project/OFF-Explorer) — Modern front-end for Open Food Facts
- [OpenStreetMap iD tagging schema overhaul](https://nlnet.nl/project/OSM-iD-tagging) — Improve OSM iD tagging to expand capabilities of OpenStreetMap editors
- [pgmpy: Open-Source Infrastructure for Causal AI](https://nlnet.nl/project/pgmpy) — Machine learning for determining cause-and-effect relationships

### Services + Applications (e.g. email, instant messaging, video chat, collaboration)

- [Castopod v2](https://nlnet.nl/project/Castopod-v2) — ActivityPub-capable podcast server
- [Follow-me slideshow for Jitsi](https://nlnet.nl/project/Follow-me-slideshow-Jitsi)— Accessible Collabora Online slideshow plugin for videoconferencing
- [Full Accessibility of the LaTeX Ecosystem](https://nlnet.nl/project/LaTeX-Ecosystem-A11y) — Systematic Tagging of Heading Structures in LaTeX
- [MistServer Video-on-Demand](https://nlnet.nl/project/MistServer-VoD) — Turning MistServer into an open distributed caching and processing node for VoD
- [PeerTube Scalability](https://nlnet.nl/project/PeerTube-Scalability) — Horizontally scalable video hosting
- [Plugging end-to-end encryption in Posca](https://nlnet.nl/project/Posca) — End-to-end encrypted communication client
- [Fleetbase × Taler: Payments for Global Logistics](https://nlnet.nl/project/Fleetbase-Taler/)— Enable Taler payments in logistics/supply chain software
- [Taler PoS](https://nlnet.nl/project/TALER-POS/)
- [Taler iOS automation](https://nlnet.nl/project/Taler-iOS-automation/)

### Vertical use cases, Search, Community

- [CoMaps Cycling Maps and Fresh Map Updates](https://nlnet.nl/project/CoMaps) — Easy-to-use, privacy-focused offline mobile map app
- [Generic e-invoicing module for Dolibarr](https://nlnet.nl/project/Dolibarr-e-invoice) — Support for electronic invoicing platforms
- [Karrot UX](https://nlnet.nl/project/Karrot-UX) — Community self-organisation, building and governance
- [Ruuti](https://nlnet.nl/project/Ruuti) — Open-source EUDI-compatible development wallet
- [Sacr3d](https://nlnet.nl/project/sacr3d) — Scheme-based graphics and math rendering toolkit
- [Zotero Plugin Ecosystem and Infrastructure](https://nlnet.nl/project/Zotero-plugin-ecosystem) — Consolidate Zotero Research Management Platform plugin system

Still hungry for more projects? Check out the [overview of all our current and recent projects](https://nlnet.nl/project/current.html)...

## Acknowledgements

The NGI0 Commons Fund, NGI Taler and NGI Fediversity are made possible with financial support from the [European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/)'s [Next Generation Internet](https://ngi.eu/) programme, under the aegis of [DG Communications Networks, Content and Technology](https://ec.europa.eu/info/departments/communications-networks-content-and-technology_en). Additional funding for the NGI0 Commons Fund is made available by the [Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation](https://www.sbfi.admin.ch/sbfi/en/home.html) (SERI).

### Tags

- [diversity and inclusion](https://www.apc.org/en/tags/diversity-and-inclusion)
- [free software](https://www.apc.org/en/tags/free-software)
- [floss](https://www.apc.org/en/tags/floss)
